name: Pools of Arlithrien
summary: South of Darnassus, danger and neglect have overtaken the Pools of Arlithrien. Their moonwell no longer draws night elves to a quiet sanctuary, as beasts and nearby Gnarlpine furbolgs threaten the springs.

sections.title: A Troubled Sanctuary
sections.body: Beneath Teldrassil’s shaded boughs, the Pools of Arlithrien lie south of Darnassus. A stone moonwell rests at their heart, its waters touched by Elune’s grace. Danger has driven the night elves to leave the sanctuary untended, though it lies near their capital. Agitated beasts roam the shallows, and hostile Gnarlpine furbolgs remain nearby. A quiet retreat has become a place troubled by dangers across the island.

faq.q: Where are the Pools of Arlithrien located?
faq.answer: The Pools of Arlithrien lie in western Teldrassil, just south of the main bridge and entrance to Darnassus.

faq.q: Why was the moonwell here abandoned?
faq.answer: The night elves stopped tending the moonwell as danger mounted. Hostile Gnarlpine furbolgs settled nearby, while aggressive forest wildlife overran the surrounding waters.

faq.q: What threats can travelers find at the pools?
faq.answer: Aggressive woodland creatures roam the waters, and nearby territorial Gnarlpine furbolgs threaten travelers.

faq.q: Can players still use the moonwell at the Pools of Arlithrien?
faq.answer: Yes. Though local dangers led the priesthood and druids to leave the moonwell untended, its sacred waters remain a functional source of lunar essence.

angles.text: As a night elf, you may read a troubling sign in a holy moonwell left untended so close to Darnassus. Corruption and disruption are spreading across Teldrassil.
As a druid studying Teldrassil’s imbalances, you may see unruly wildlife and a neglected moonwell as signs that the Great Tree lacks nature’s true blessing.
